name: What are the signs that my bedroom windows need replacing?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs that my bedroom windows need replacing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs include drafts, difficulty opening or closing, condensation between glass panes, increased energy bills, and visible damage like rot or decay on the frames. Older windows, especially single-pane models, often lack proper insulation, leading to uncomfortable temperatures and higher heating or cooling costs. Replacing them can improve comfort, reduce noise, and enhance your home's energy efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drafts, condensation, high energy bills, and difficulty operating are key signs your bedroom windows may need replacement.
